Первый раз: от приглашения до своей пала: First time: from invitation to your tent
Подробный маршрут подготовки, который по: A detailed preparation route that helps leave room for the unexpected without leaving everything to chance.
Дорога начинается с вопроса «куда я еду?: The road begins with the question “Where am I going?”
Сообщение от друга может быть коротким:: A message from a friend can be short: people are gathering in the forest, you can come. But between this invitation and the ticket for the trip there is a small conversation. What kind of meeting is this? Who gave the information? What year was the announcement? Is there an up-to-date connection with people on the ground? Temporary communities change faster than pages that were once searched.
Сохрани исходное приглашение и уточни ус: Save the original invitation and check the terms with its source. Ask about access, the last leg of the journey, water, terrain, weather and the return journey. Participants may be busy with preparations and may not respond immediately. This is another reason to start a conversation in advance, and not expect to solve everything with the last message from a nearly dead phone.
В первую очередь подумай о сне, тепле, в: First of all, think about sleep, warmth, water, food and the ability to leave. The tent and sleeping bag should suit the real weather, and not the image of a summer forest. Find out how many things you will have to carry yourself and whether there is a connection at the last section. Comfortable shoes and a flashlight influence first impressions no less than the mood before the trip.
Личные лекарства и необходимые средства: Personal medications and necessary hygiene products must be taken with you. If there are dietary, health, or accessibility considerations, discuss specific conditions in advance and prepare your own backup plan. Friendly people don't always have the right equipment, transportation, or experience. The ability to refuse unsuitable conditions is a normal part of traveling independently.
Не нужно покупать особый образ жизни, чт: You don't have to buy a special lifestyle to come. Personal items are chosen according to their usefulness, and the contribution to general life can be small and very ordinary. If you want to bring food or tools, first ask what you really need and how to deliver it. An unexpected large object sometimes adds more worries than it solves problems.
Твоё время и готовность учиться — тоже в: Your time and willingness to learn are also a contribution. Leave your energy for rest, acquaintance and the way back. If you are constantly picking up unfinished tasks, it is easy to get tired and stop noticing your own needs. Choose what you can, agree to delegate the task, and allow yourself a break. It is easier for us to take care of a common home when participation leaves room for taking care of ourselves.
Когда ты дошёл до Welcome Home: When did you reach Welcome Home
Остановись и узнай основные ориентиры. Г: Stop and learn the main landmarks. Where is it allowed to pitch a tent? What kind of water is intended for drinking? Where are the toilets and information point? How are urgent messages sent? If the entrance area is small or currently empty, ask nearby participants who have up-to-date information. The form of greeting varies from meeting to meeting.
Необязательно сразу идти за самой громко: You don’t have to immediately follow the loudest company. You can first choose a quiet place, eat after the road and get an idea of ​​the camp. Write down or remember landmarks during the day: similar paths look different at night. A familiar name and a clear path to the tent often give more confidence than trying to see everything in one evening.
Выбери соседство, а не только площадку: Choose a neighborhood, not just a site
Выбирая место для палатки, ты выбираешь: When choosing a place for a tent, you choose a small neighborhood. Take a closer look: where it is quiet, where they play music, where families live and where the kitchen is located. Ask if the site is open and if there is a trail or work area going through it. Say hello to the people nearby. A short conversation before setting up the tent can often help you feel more confident and avoid inconvenience.
Обрати внимание на склон, сток дождевой: Pay attention to slope, rainwater runoff and local restrictions. Do not change the designated areas and do not create your own household solutions where there is already a coordinated system. If the camp structure does not meet your needs, this is a reason to look for another option, rather than silently endure in the hope of getting used to it.
Первое дело и первые имена: Your first task and first familiar names
Подойти к общей кухне и спросить, нужна: Walking up to the shared kitchen and asking if you need help can be easier than introducing yourself to everyone at once. Choose an understandable task and ask to see the order. Shared work provides natural topics for conversation and allows you to see people in action. You don't have to be talkative or interesting all the time to be close.
Если ты пока устал или не готов включать: If you are tired yet or not ready to join in, you can say so. Giving up a specific cause is not the same as giving up a community. It is important not to disappear in the middle of an agreed-upon task without warning and not to consider strangers obligated to guess your state. Clear small agreements help both the common cause and personal peace of mind.
Что стоит спросить в первый день: What to ask on the first day
Кроме карты лагеря, узнай, как сообщают: In addition to a map of the camp, learn how changes are reported, where to look for lost items, and how general issues are discussed. Specify the conditions for filming, silence and participation in practices. If you come with children or animals, pre-agreed answers need to be checked on the spot: camp opportunities and local agreements may have changed.
Не бойся переспрашивать незнакомые слова: Don't be afraid to ask again unfamiliar words. Main Circle, Magic Hat, Shanti Sena and focalizer may indicate recognizable ideas, but do not guarantee the same organization. The question “what does this mean here?” useful for both a beginner and a person with experience of another meeting. It leaves room for reality, and not just the usual picture.
Обратная дорога — часть приезда: The return journey is part of the arrival
В день прибытия легко забыть, что когда-: On the day of arrival, it’s easy to forget that someday you will need transport, a phone charge, strength and dry things again. Keep the return route and the necessary reserve separate from the hope of a random ride. If you agree to travel with someone, discuss time, luggage and how to contact if plans change. The freedom to improvise is more comfortable when there is a clear way out.
Оставь время на сборы и уборку до назнач: Leave time for packing and cleaning before your scheduled departure. Check not only the tent, but also the path to it, the neighboring site, and common things you used. If you can help the final group, agree on a specific case. A good goodbye allows you to leave with gratitude and not leave your part of the job to the unknown next person.
От первого Welcome Home до понимания, чт: From the first Welcome Home to the understanding that the common house has no spectator seats.
Представь: дорога остаётся за спиной, вп: Imagine: the road remains behind you, ahead are tents, unfamiliar voices and paths. Someone is carrying dishes, someone is looking for friends, someone is showing where to get water. They tell you Welcome Home. You don't need to know everyone right away, understand every word, or feel at home from the first minute. Stop, breathe and look around. The acquaintance has already begun.
Rainbow Gathering — временное сообщество: Rainbow Gathering is a temporary community in nature. It consists of the participation of those who come: they cook, arrange everyday life, talk, play music and take care of the place. Meetings do not have a single center that represents all participants. Therefore, getting to know Rainbow begins with both a general idea and a very specific question: how is this meeting organized?
Our common home begins with simple things. The water should be in the kitchen, the dishes should be clean again. A new person needs to be shown the way. After the rain, we check to see if the trail has washed out and if it’s dry near the tents. The Rainbow atmosphere is born right here: in the song around the fire and in the care of the person who prepared the permitted dry firewood for it. You can become part of this story with the smallest thing.
Участие не требует заранее выбрать роль: Participation does not require pre-selecting a role for the entire duration of the trip. You can start with a small, understandable task, ask how it is done, and agree on a time. It is more important to honestly identify your strengths than to promise a lot and disappear. Rest is also necessary: ​​overall life becomes more stable when work does not depend on several people who have long been tired and do not know how to stop.
Ты можешь услышать слово focalizer — так: You may hear the word focalizer - this is the name of a person who helps people gather around a specific cause. This could be the kitchen, communicating information, purchasing or cleaning. If you have a question, ask who is currently working on the required task. This person will help you navigate, but is not responsible for your entire trip and does not solely decide for the entire camp.
Фокализация — это прежде всего общение и: Focusing is all about communication and caring about business. Do you know how the kitchen works? Show it to someone else. Do you know how to find the products you need? Tell me how it turns out. Good coordination opens up the work to new people and helps share responsibilities. Instead of looking for the main thing, try asking: “Who is doing this now and how can I connect?” This creates a place for your participation.
Для обсуждения общих вопросов на многих: Many meetings use circles to discuss general issues. In some, an object is passed on, indicating the turn to speak; in others, the order is maintained differently. The ability to listen, not interrupt, and explain the objection in a way that can be worked through is important. Consensus in this context is about finding a solution that stakeholders can live with, rather than simply counting hands raised.
Такой разговор бывает медленным. Не все: This conversation can be slow. Not everyone speaks with equal confidence, knows the language, or understands the history of the discussion. The absence of an official position does not in itself eliminate the influence of experience, volume of voice and personal connections. Therefore, paying attention to the quiet participants and clearly communicating the decision made is no less important than the shape of the circle itself. Silence should not automatically be taken as understanding.
Семья — приглашение, а не обязательство: Family is an invitation, not an obligation.
Слова «братья», «сёстры» и Welcome Home: The words "brothers", "sisters" and Welcome Home express a desire for closeness. But it may take time for a person to get used to a new place, people and way of communication. One can feel loneliness among a large circle. You may not want hugs. You can value a meeting and still need silence, personal space, or an early departure. These conditions do not make participation wrong.
Тёплые отношения возникают из повторяющи: Warm relationships arise from repeated small meetings: you wash the pot with others, meet again on the trail, remember a name, agree on the next task. You don't have to expect a special experience on the first evening. It is much more useful to leave people the opportunity to be different and not turn the idea of ​​family into a requirement to trust every stranger.
Временный характер Gathering помогает за: The temporary nature of Gathering helps you notice how many familiar things can be done differently. But this does not mean that every practice is suitable for everyone or that difficulties disappear with good intentions. This also requires conversations about boundaries, accessibility, workload and conflicts. Contradictions are part of a living community, and not evidence that someone is not open enough.
После отъезда можно увезти не только вос: After leaving, you can take away not only the memory of a beautiful place. What remains is the experience of noticing unfinished business, asking about needs, sharing a skill without superiority, and thanking for invisible work. This begins the connection between the temporary home in the forest and ordinary life, to which everyone returns in their own way.
История одного приёма пищи: вода, работа: The story of one meal: water, work, donations and people who are easy to miss.
Еда начинается задолго до круга: Eating starts long before the circle
Когда мы видим готовую миску еды, больша: When we see a finished bowl of food, much of its history has already been left behind the scenes. Someone found out what products are needed. Others coordinated the purchase, found transport, brought the stock and dismantled it. Then water appeared, a clean work area, people with knives and a man who noticed that it was time to wash a large cauldron. At a meeting this chain is shorter and more visible than in the city, but it does not become automatic.
На кухне ты быстро замечаешь, как связан: In the kitchen, you quickly notice how different aspects of common life are connected: food, voluntary donations, work, clean water and the ability to negotiate. Somewhere there is one large kitchen, somewhere there are several small ones. Come, say hello, find out when help is needed and how food is distributed here. Even if you have already been to another Gathering, leave room for a new acquaintance: each common cauldron has its own rhythm.
Первая помощь кухне — хороший вопрос: Helping in the kitchen starts with a good question
Чтобы помочь, не обязательно уметь готов: You don't have to know how to cook for a large group to help. Start with a question about the current task: what needs to be done, who will show you the order, what tools can you take? Sometimes it is more important to clean up a vacated surface or carry clean dishes than to join in the most visible task. A coordinated small action helps more than a big improvement that no one asked for.
Если ты берёшься за работу впервые, попр: If you are taking on a job for the first time, ask to see the result you need. Where are peeled vegetables stored? What water is intended for what? Who is responsible for the distribution? Knowing these details is not a sign of special status: it is experience that can be passed on. And if you have twenty minutes of energy left, it’s better to say so directly and agree to transfer the task.
Magic Hat: общие нужды, добровольный вкл: Magic Hat: general needs, voluntary contribution
Magic Hat — «волшебная шляпа» — это добр: Magic Hat - “magic hat” is a voluntary collection for general needs. This is how we together pay for food, transportation, and everything the camp cannot live without. If you can, put a reasonable amount in your hat. Money is only one way to participate: food, time, skills and hands are also needed. The absence of a ticket does not eliminate expenses, but it allows everyone to help according to their capabilities.
Пожертвование — участие в общем деле. Он: Donation is participation in a common cause. It doesn't buy a special seat, a special menu, or the right to demand service. If it's important to you to understand where the money is going, ask how expenses are discussed and where records can be seen. An open conversation about purchasing helps build trust: behind the food there are real products, trips and decisions of the people with whom you share the space.
Чистая миска — часть общей заботы: A clean bowl is part of the overall care
Личная миска, кружка и ложка помогают вк: A personal bowl, mug and spoon help you get involved in everyday life without constant dependence on other people's utensils. But the story doesn't end after the hand. You need to understand where to wash things, how clean and dirty water flows work, where leftover food goes, and who changes the water in the common area. If you don't understand the system, it's best to ask before you jump into anything at all.
На общей кухне чистота — забота о каждом: In the shared kitchen, cleanliness is a concern for everyone who comes for food. Wash your hands before work, learn the dishwashing procedures, and use the designated areas. Keep your personal bowl separate from serving utensils. If you are feeling unwell, alert the people at the kitchen and rest instead of handling food. If you notice a problem with water or food storage, tell us about it right away and ask for help to sort it out.
За столом встречаются разные потребности: Different needs meet at the table
На многих встречах общую еду готовят рас: At many meetings, shared food is prepared from plants: this makes it easier for people with different habits to share one pot. But the composition of a particular dish is always worth clarifying. If you have allergies or special needs, talk to the kitchen in advance and take a suitable supply with you. You know better than others what you need; clear conversation helps you take care of yourself and doesn't leave the kitchen guessing.
Общий круг перед едой тоже может выгляде: The general circle before eating may also look different. Some come for the sake of communication, others are tired and want to eat in peace. Participation in song, prayer or other practice should not be considered a requirement of respect. Attention to people is manifested not only in general form, but also in the ability to choose a comfortable way to be present.
После ужина остаются тяжёлые кастрюли, р: After dinner, there are heavy pots, countertops, tools, and the next meal. At this point, it is especially noticeable whether the work is divided or simply repeating the day of several regular volunteers. You can ask what will help you complete your shift, not just start a nice new task. And you can thank people whose work is usually not visible from the circle.
Кухня учит очень конкретному виду взаимн: The kitchen teaches a very specific kind of reciprocity: to see the path from a common need to a common result. Returning here the next day, you already know a couple of names, the location of things and your own strengths. An unfamiliar place gradually becomes familiar, not because someone declared you part of the family, but because you did what was needed together.
Личные границы, фотографии, тишина и пра: Personal boundaries, photographs, silence and the right to disagree - encounters in everyday life.
Приветствие не задаёт единственный спосо: Greeting does not set the only method of intimacy
На входе человека могут встретить улыбко: At the entrance, a person may be greeted with a smile, a word, or an offer of a hug. Good intention is important, but the method of greeting remains the choice of both people. For some, a hug from a stranger is pleasant; for others, a nod is enough. Being able to calmly say “no hugs, thank you” makes the space more welcoming to a wider range of people.
Личные границы не противоречат открытост: Personal boundaries do not contradict openness. They help you understand how to be present without guesswork and pressure. Consent refers to a specific action and a specific moment. Yesterday's permission to hug does not mean permission today; Consenting to a shoulder massage does not mean consenting to other touches. You can change your mind, stop, or not explain the refusal in detail.
Увидев красивый круг, легко потянуться з: When you see a beautiful circle, it's easy to reach for your phone before noticing the people inside the frame. For the shooter it is a memory of a trip, but for another person it is an image of their body, location or personal life that may end up in an unfamiliar audience. Therefore, the question of shooting is important before pressing the button, and not after.
Спроси всех узнаваемых людей и отдельно: Ask all recognizable people and separately agree on publication. Permission to leave a photo in a personal archive is not the same as permission to post it in an open channel. If you can't be sure the group agrees, you can choose a landscape, details of your own camp, or another shot. Refusal does not require an argument that the site is common and everyone should be more free.
Палатка — чей-то временный дом. Кружка,: A tent is someone's temporary home. A mug, a tool and warm clothes remain personal things, even when it is common to share. Before you take someone else's, ask and wait for an answer. When approaching a visit, call the person outside; don't look inside without an invitation. Small gestures like these allow us to open our home to others and calmly maintain our personal space.
Тишина — ещё одна граница, которую не ви: Silence is another border that is not visible on the map. Children may be sleeping with neighbors; a person may be recovering from a trip or simply going to bed early. It’s easier to ask in advance about the rhythm of a neighboring camp than to find out later why your favorite music bothers someone. Paying attention to the acoustics of the place does not make the meeting less lively, but allows different rhythms to coexist.
Близость не возникает по расписанию: Intimacy doesn't happen on a schedule.
Если ты мечтаешь о дружбе или близости,: If you dream of friendship or intimacy, give the relationship time. Friendliness, nudity, dancing or practicing together does not constitute an invitation to sexual contact. You can have a conversation with pleasure and not want to continue. Ask directly, listen to the answer and accept refusal without persuasion. The warmth of the meeting becomes real where a person can choose with whom and how to be close.
Полезно дать отношениям время: увидеть д: It is useful to give the relationship time: to see each other in work, fatigue, play and everyday conversations. Doing something together does not create a debt of gratitude in the form of attention or intimacy. If the invitation is not accepted, a respectful response ends the request rather than turning it into a series of attempts to persuade. A person still has the right to change plans without being punished by coldness or ridicule.
Не нужно сначала доказать, что ситуация: There is no need to first prove that the situation is serious enough to get out of it. You can move away, find someone you know and ask for escort or a quiet place. Find out in advance how issues are reported at the meeting and where support and communication are available. Mutual aid practices, sometimes called Shanti Sena, vary in composition and scope.
Если к тебе обратились, начни со слушани: If you are approached, start by listening and asking what help is needed. Don't turn a story into a general discussion without the person's permission and don't promise a result you can't deliver. When there is an immediate threat, the priority is safety and contacting appropriate emergency services. Social circle is not a substitute for professional help.
Дети, доверие и ответственность взрослых: Children, trust and responsibility of adults
С детьми на Радуге могут складываться др: Friendships, games and a small neighborhood can develop with children on Rainbow. But Kid Village or children's camp does not mean that the child can be left without an agreement. Get to know the people you trust to care for you, discuss the time and place of the meeting. Show your child the way to the tent and explain who to contact. General goodwill complements your attention to the child, and does not replace it.
Детские границы требуют такого же внимат: Children's boundaries require the same careful attention to touch and photographs. Agreement with an adult does not cancel the child’s own reluctance. The concern for safety here is not limited to prohibitions: it includes familiarity, predictable agreements and the ability to say without shame that you don’t like something. The warm atmosphere becomes more convincing when these words are actually heard.
Вода, тропы и последние дни: почему убор: Water, trails and the last days: why cleaning begins even before getting ready for the trip.
Пейзаж не пустует до нашего приезда: The landscape is not empty before our arrival
На несколько дней лес может стать твоим: For a few days the forest can become your home. At the same time, the place already has its own life: soil, plants, animals, streams and people who live nearby. Before you put up a tent or choose a path, take a closer look: what will change from our presence? We are visiting this place and want to leave so that it continues to live its own rhythm.
Временность помогает сохранять меру. Не: Temporality helps to maintain moderation. Not every improvement idea needs to be implemented, not every shortcut needs to become a new path. It's helpful to use established passages, learn about sensitive areas, and not mistake a nice spot for automatically camping. Land agreements and local restrictions should be checked with a current source.
В документе вода появляется почти в кажд: In the document, water appears in almost every section: when choosing a place, organizing the kitchen, washing dishes and placing living areas. This shows the general principle: what is convenient for one person for a few minutes can change the conditions for everyone who uses the source. Therefore, near water, it is important to know not only the short path, but also the procedure for handling it.
По приезде узнай, где брать питьевую вод: Upon arrival, find out where to get drinking water, where to wash and how to wash things. Use the places provided for this and keep the streams away from soap and dirty dishes. A seemingly clean stream is not necessarily drinkable. If you do not understand how the water is prepared, ask those who deal with it, and use your supply until a clear answer is given. Taking care of water is a daily part of everyday life.
Кусочек верёвки, крышка, окурок или обре: A piece of rope, a cap, a cigarette butt or a piece of packaging seems like a small thing until hundreds of people leave them behind. The same applies to the trampled edge of the stream and new detours of the dirty place. Subtle personal choices become a noticeable shared imprint. Therefore, cleaning works better when it happens every day, and not just after the last circle is announced.
Можно держать небольшой мешок под рукой,: You can keep a small bag at hand, check the place where you sat, and take yours away right away. If you notice someone else's trash, help does not have to be accompanied by a public remark. And if agreement is needed - for example, about collecting waste from the kitchen - it is more useful to offer an understandable system than to hope that everyone understands the word “clean” in the same way.
Огонь собирает нас вместе: согревает, по: Fire brings us together: it warms us, helps us cook and leaves room for evening song. At the same time, it requires constant attention. Use approved common fireplaces, find out who is currently watching the fire, and do not leave the fire unattended. If fire is prohibited in this area, respect the prohibition. The tradition of a communal fire makes sense along with caring for the forest and people.
Сначала узнай, можно ли разводить огонь: First, find out if it is possible to make a fire here, and use the agreed upon common fireplace. Don't hand over the care of the fire to a random next person: agree who stays and make sure the fire is completed properly. Even a familiar place changes with the weather and the season. Taking care of the forest means noticing the real conditions today.
До отъезда можно решить судьбу будущих о: Before leaving, you can decide the fate of future waste. Reusable utensils, moderate packing, and less unnecessary packaging make the last few days easier. Think not only about how to get the item to camp, but also how to get it back if wet, dirty or damaged. A broken tent does not become a gift to the next participant just because it was left along the trail.
Возьми подходящие мешки и выясните досту: Get suitable bags and find out the available removal options. It cannot be assumed that the nearest village should accept all the rubbish of the meeting. A separate pile of recyclables also does not mean recycling: it must be backed by a clear recipient and transport. The clearer this chain is in advance, the less work and uncertainty is left for the last people.
Последняя группа тоже часть Радуги: The last group is also part of Rainbow
После общего прощания у некоторых начина: After a general farewell, some begin the most stressful part of their work. It is necessary to remove temporary structures, collect forgotten things, check distant parking areas and agree on the end of use of the place. The camp is getting smaller, but there are still many tasks. The plans of those who leave earlier directly affect how much effort those who remain will need.
Не обязательно оставаться последним, что: You don't have to be last to share this responsibility. You can set aside time before your departure to complete a specific area and convey information about unfinished business. The meeting ends not with one beautiful photograph of an empty clearing, but with many decisions, after which the place ceases to need our attention. This is a quiet, difficult and very human part of the history of a common home.
Как незнакомые люди становятся кругом, п: How strangers form a circle, pass on traditions and keep in touch after the journey home.
Первое Rainbow Gathering состоялось в Ко: The first Rainbow Gathering took place in Colorado in 1972. The European history of meetings is usually counted from 1983, from the border area between Italy and Switzerland. These landmarks help situate the movement in time, but do not explain the diversity of people and practices who associate themselves with Rainbow today. Between two dates and a live meeting there are many personal paths.
Ты можешь услышать очень разные рассказы: You can hear very different stories about Rainbow. For one, the main thing was the general circle, for another - days in the kitchen, for the third - a quiet meeting on the trail. These memories don't have to match. Listen, ask, and leave room for your experiences. The history of our movement consists of many such roads and people who one day decided to be together differently.
Когда палатки разобраны, знакомство може: When the tents are dismantled, acquaintance can continue: by letter, call, local circle or dinner with friends. Previously, this was done by exchanging addresses and producing small printed pages; Today they have added forums and chats. The methods of communication are changing, but the desire remains the same - not to lose the people with whom I shared food, work and several important days.
Если хочешь увидеться снова, спроси, как: If you want to see each other again, ask how the person is comfortable communicating. A phone number does not mean an invitation to come home, and friendship at a meeting does not cancel someone else's routine. Agree in advance, find out if the time is right, and calmly accept the answer. This way, hospitality remains voluntary, and the connection between us does not turn into an obligation to always be available.
Традиции передаются через участие: Traditions are passed on through participation
Радужные традиции учатся жить в маленьки: Rainbow traditions learn to live in small actions. Someone shows you where to wash your hands before the kitchen, another explains the order of the circle, a third takes you with him to clean. You can watch it first, then try it together and eventually help the beginner yourself. Thus, experience passes through hands and conversations, and a new camp begins to be built with the memory of previous meetings.
У разных встреч будут свои привычки и ус: Different meetings will have their own habits and conditions. Instead of arguing about how things should be everywhere, ask why things are done this way here. Sometimes there is a simple reason for the decision: the water source is far away, families live nearby, or the location is particularly sensitive to noise. Understanding the meaning helps to preserve tradition and at the same time find a suitable way of common life in new circumstances.
Идеал равенства и реальная жизнь: The ideal of equality and real life
Мы стремимся к равному участию и общей о: We strive for equal participation and shared responsibility. But experience, language skills and speaking confidence are distributed differently. Some people easily find themselves in the center, while others find it difficult to get a word in. If you notice such a difference, help make the conversation clearer: explain an unfamiliar word, offer a translation, ask the quiet person if he wants to speak. Equality needs daily attention.
Умея что-то делать, легко незаметно взят: Knowing how to do something, it’s easy to quietly take over everything. Try to stop in time and invite someone else to study nearby. The explanation at first takes more time, but after it two people are able to support the common cause. Share tools and knowledge, delegate tasks and relax. A free community is stronger when no one has to be indispensable.
Традиции меняют смысл в разных местах: Traditions change meaning in different places
Названия кругов, отношение к технике, ус: The names of circles, attitudes towards technology, the arrangement of children's space and musical life may differ between regions and meetings. Some participants associate their experience with a spiritual quest, others with community life, nature or creativity. This does not mean that everyone must share one belief system in order to understand what is happening or participate in the work.
Встречаясь с людьми из разных культур, м: As we meet people from different cultures, we become familiar with their songs, words, and ways of coming together. If you are interested in an unfamiliar tradition, find out its origins and listen to those for whom it is native. Not everything you see needs to be repeated or called your own. Respecting others' stories helps us meet without appropriation and leaves room for real sharing.
Следующая глава не обязана быть большой: The next chapter doesn't have to be long
Тебе не обязательно ждать следующего бол: You don't have to wait for the next big Gathering. You can invite your friends for a joint dinner, a walk, music or a small circle. Start with what you can: agree on a place and time, invite everyone to bring something to the table, and take care of cleaning together. A small meeting also provides space for acquaintance, participation and attentive conversation.
История продолжается и в том, как ты вст: The story continues in how you meet the next person: you explain an unfamiliar word, offer to try something, and reserve the right to refuse. You can take away this way of being close to Rainbow and gradually find a place for it in your everyday life. If you want, the next chapter will begin with your simple invitation: “Let's get together.”

Сначала возникло желание собраться: At first there was a desire to get together
История не начинается с готовой программ: History does not begin with a ready-made program and a set of familiar names. In the memories of the participants, the preparation for the first meeting is associated with travel, conversations, invitations and the search for a way to gather for the sake of peace. The countercultural milieu of the late 1960s and early 1970s gave language to this search: criticism of war and consumerism, interest in nature and experimentation with everyday life.
Первое большое Rainbow Gathering состоял: The first big Rainbow Gathering took place in Colorado in 1972. Imagine how far the paths of people who once met in the mountains have diverged since then. Some returned, some invited friends, some brought the idea of ​​a common home to another place. There are many backstories and voices to this story; the date helps to find the beginning of a long journey, but does not contain everything that people brought with them.
Приглашение сообщает больше, чем время и: An invitation communicates more than time and place. It retains the authors' expectations, the words they used to address strangers, and the idea of ​​what a temporary shared life might look like. Next to it, a letter, diary or sheet about the work of the kitchen shows another layer of the same meeting: not only the dream, but also the actions that were needed to realize it.
Попробуй представить старое приглашение: Try to imagine an old invitation in the hands of a person who does not yet know what awaits him. In short words - finding the way, making first acquaintances, waiting for the general circle. Traces of this daily life are preserved in letters, drawings and notes. They remind you that the history of Rainbow consists not only of great events, but also of ordinary human attempts to meet.
Европейское начало: важна оговорка о гра: The European beginning: a border matters
Европейскую историю больших Gathering об: The European history of large Gatherings is usually counted from 1983. The first such trip is connected with the borderlands of Italy and Switzerland and a change of meeting place. Already at this beginning, a familiar rainbow road is visible: plans change, people look for each other, and a common home gathers where they happened to be together. Then the circle of meetings gradually spread throughout Europe.
Европейские встречи развивались через пе: European meetings developed through the movement of people, local acquaintances and the transfer of experience. This is not a branch network in which the center has opened identical branches. When people moved, they brought language, skills, and expectations, and the conditions of the new place required different arrangements. Similar names could be preserved despite markedly different structures of daily life.
Архивное Rainbow Rising 1998 года позвол: The archived Rainbow Rising from 1998 reveals an interest in international connections, practical knowledge and the sharing of stories. Such publications kept the conversation going after the camp ended: they helped find a familiar topic, understand other people's experiences, and imagine the next opportunity to meet. The paper page performed part of the work that websites and correspondence take on today.
Но архив нельзя читать как действующее п: But the archive cannot be read as a valid invitation. The specified plan does not yet prove the event took place, and a printed contact does not become permission to contact a person decades later. We use the publication as evidence of its time and do not transfer its personal information to an open modern library.
Участник может описывать встречу через п: The participant may describe the encounter through experience, and the researcher through observed practices and social connections. The archivist answers another question: what documents have been preserved and where they came from. These perspectives are not necessarily mutually exclusive. They allow us to notice that there is a difference between the emotional truth of a memory and the exact confirmation of a detail.
Особенно внимательно стоит относиться к: Particular attention should be paid to stories about the ancient origin of symbols and borrowed spiritual practices. Just because a plot is often repeated within a community does not make it an established historical fact. It is possible to respect the meaning of the image for the participants while also asking who first recorded it and whose cultural tradition it represents.
История продолжается обычными действиями: The story continues with normal actions
Радуга передаётся не только через юбилеи: Rainbow is not only transmitted through anniversaries and large gatherings. It remains in the way the newcomer was explained the way, handed over the work of the kitchen, or given the opportunity to speak out. These small episodes rarely fall into the general chronology, but it is through them that the next generation learns what familiar words mean in practice.
Если тебе хочется узнать историю глубже,: If you want to know the story further, ask people who remember other meetings and share what interested you. Compare stories, notice differences, and remain curious. And if you're packing your backpack for the first time, remember: you don't need to know all the dates to enter the circle. Your own story of meeting Rainbow is yet to come.
Круг — это способ слушать: A circle is a way of listening
Talking Circle, общий совет и консенсус:: Talking Circle, general advice and consensus: similar forms, different tasks and work that is not visible in the photo.
Люди могут сидеть кругом перед едой, дел: People can sit in a circle before eating, share experiences, discuss a domestic problem, or choose the next step in preparation. The external form is similar, but the task is different. The speaking circle is not necessarily the council with authority to decide the issue for the entire meeting. The first useful question from the participant is about why we are meeting now.
Ты можешь услышать названия Main Council: You may hear the names Main Council, Talking Circle and Vision Council. One circle discusses today's life, the other helps everyone to speak out, the third is dedicated to a future meeting. Find out why people have gathered now and how the turn to speak works. There is no need to remember all the names in advance: a simple question will help you enter the conversation with understanding.
Очередь говорить создаёт место: The turn to speak creates space
В некоторых описаниях передают предмет,: Some descriptions convey an object that shows who is speaking. In others, they do without it, maintaining order with attention or the help of a conversation leader. The subject itself does not have the power to make discussion respectful. What matters is the agreement to let the person finish and not take up the entire space of the answer before it appears.
Слушать — не то же самое, что просто жда: Listening is not the same as simply waiting your turn. You can check whether a thought is correctly understood, clarify an unfamiliar word, and separate a question from an objection. If people speak different languages, pauses are needed for translation. Sometimes a short repetition of a sentence does more to promote a joint decision than another long speech.
Консенсус — не соревнование громкости: Consensus is not a volume competition
В консенсусе мы ищем решение, с которым: In consensus we seek a solution we can live with together. Start by understanding the proposal: what exactly will change, who will be affected, and who will be willing to take action? If something is unclear, ask for clarification. If you see a serious difficulty, name it and help them look for another option. Both the desire to agree and the honesty of a person who cannot yet agree are valuable here.
Возражение может показать потребность, к: An objection may reveal a need that was not previously noticed. It is useful to discuss its content and possible changes in the decision, without reducing the conversation to the character of the objecting person. However, the name of the process itself does not guarantee the result. Different circles may have different rules about blocking, reviewing proposals, and decision boundaries.
Новому человеку бывает трудно говорить р: It can be difficult for a new person to speak next to those who have known each other and the history of the issue for a long time. An experienced participant can navigate the terms more easily, and fluency in a common language provides an additional advantage. An open circle may remain unequal in terms of real opportunity to influence, even if formally there is a place for everyone.
Присмотрись, как распределяется внимание: Take a closer look at how attention is distributed: who speaks more often, whose words are translated, who remains after the circle to do unnoticed work. You can help by taking on some of the work yourself or inviting others to share it. You can ask to repeat the solution in understandable language and check whether the newcomer’s question was heard. From such actions equality becomes tangible.
Что делает фокалайзер разговора: What does a conversation focalizer do?
Человек, помогающий кругу, может напомин: The person helping the circle can remind the topic, clarify a sentence, monitor the line, and notice that a break is needed. This is a useful feature as long as it helps others participate. It does not mean the right to quietly choose the desired outcome or to present one's own version of the conversation as the only common voice.
Если ты помогаешь вести круг, делай поря: If you are helping to lead a circle, make the order of the conversation clear to others. Explain how to convey a question, how an objection is raised, and where to find out the outcome. Invite someone to try this role next to you. When skills are transferred, the conversation remains common even after the most experienced people leave and opens up more easily to those who come for the first time.
Даже хороший круг не заканчивается ощуще: Even a good circle does not end with the feeling that everyone has heard each other. Clarity is needed about the next step: who will communicate the decision to those who were not there, who is performing the task, and when they will return to it. Without this, different people may come away with different ideas about what happened.
Участие не обязательно означает выступат: Participation does not necessarily mean speaking out on every issue. You can listen, help translate, briefly write down an agreed sentence, or pass on information to neighbors. The circle has many types of work. When they become visible, respect ceases to be just a mood and begins to be expressed in the structure of general conversation.
Как возникает временный лагерь: выбор ме: How a temporary camp comes into being: site selection, Seed Camp, information and transfer of tasks.
Место выбирают не только глазами: People choose a place not only with their eyes
Красивая поляна становится домом постепе: A beautiful meadow gradually becomes a home. Before everyone gathers here, you need to understand where the water will come from, how to deliver food, where the trails will be and which areas of nature are especially vulnerable. If you come to help prepare, start by talking to those who already know the place. The convenience of one tent is always connected with the life of the entire camp.
Подготовка включает договорённости с тем: Preparation includes agreements with those who own or use the land and an understanding of local conditions. The forest does not become free for any use just from our desire to gather. Before inviting others, it is important to understand access, season and how much load the area will withstand. Respect for a place begins even before the first Welcome Home.
Seed Camp: первые дни общей работы: Seed Camp: the first days of general work
Seed Camp — время, когда небольшая групп: Seed Camp is the time when a small group begins to prepare the camp before the main arrival. Here a kitchen, a water system, passages, sanitary areas and the first landmarks for arrivals appear. You can help prepare if you have learned about the needs in advance and are ready to live in a space that is not yet arranged. Check the dates and tasks with the people of this meeting.
Приехать на подготовку — не то же самое,: Arriving for preparation is not the same as arriving earlier for a freer holiday. There may be a lot of work, but still few amenities. It is useful to find out the current need in advance, agree on your contribution and bring something that allows you to be independent. Otherwise, helping can quietly turn into an additional task for an already busy group.
Лагерь — сеть зависимостей: A camp is a network of interdependence
Вода нужна кухне, кухне нужны люди и про: The kitchen needs water, the kitchen needs people and products, transportation needs communication, and the new group needs understandable information. When you look at these tasks in isolation, it's easy to underestimate how changing one area affects the others. The supply disruption turns out to be more than just a purchasing issue, and the silence at the information point is not just a lack of announcements.
Координация помогает видеть соседние зад: Coordination helps to see neighboring tasks. Supply connects the kitchen with supplies, Info helps convey news, COOPerations connects different things. The names may vary, but the meaning is familiar: tell others what has already been done, what is needed now and where there are not enough hands. Even a short, clear message sometimes helps a camp more than another hour of working alone.
Входная зона помогает новому человеку пр: The entrance area helps a new person turn an unfamiliar space into a few understandable landmarks. What is important here is not only the warmth of the greeting, but also the accuracy of the answer: where is the water, where not to put the tent, how is transport access arranged and who to ask on a specific topic. Sometimes a good sign does more than a confident but outdated clue.
Люди на входе тоже нуждаются в отдыхе и: People at the entrance also need to rest and update information. If conditions have changed, the message must reach those who explain the way. So it becomes clear that hospitality does not appear on its own: it is supported by shifts, knowledge transfer and the ability to say “I’ll clarify” when there is no answer yet.
Человек, который первым начал дело, част: The person who first started the business often continues to keep it in his head even after assistants appear. Over time, this can turn participation into an ongoing responsibility and make the group dependent on one member. Texts on focalization specifically return to the risk of burnout and the need to transfer responsibility.
Для передачи мало сказать «сделайте кто-: For transmission it is not enough to say “someone do it.” It is necessary to explain the state of the problem, what is available, the boundaries of the solution and the next step. The assistant may act more slowly because he is learning. If this process is allowed to take place, knowledge gradually ceases to be a privilege and becomes a shared resource that will remain after the departure of the experienced person.
При выборе конструкции полезно думать о: When choosing a structure, it is useful to think about disassembly, when bringing in materials - about removal, when placing a camp - about restoring the site. This way, cleaning ceases to be the last section that is remembered after the holiday. It influences decisions from day one and the amount of work left to the last people.
Новичку не нужно уметь проектировать вес: A beginner doesn't need to be able to design an entire camp to see this logic. It is enough to ask how a small task is connected to the overall system and how it should end. Knowing where to return a tool and who to turn over unfinished work to is one of the most concrete ways to take care of a temporary home.
Музыка, тишина и общий ритм: Music, silence and a shared rhythm
Что создаёт атмосферу встречи и почему у: What creates the atmosphere of a meeting and why a shared space should have more than one way to sound.
Если ты играешь на инструменте, любишь п: If you play an instrument, love to sing or just listen, there is a moment for it. Music on Rainbow is born from the participation of people nearby. There is no need to wait for a ready-made program: someone remembers a song, another picks up the rhythm. Before you join, listen to what is already playing. Sometimes it’s paying attention to someone else’s melody that helps you find your voice.
В таком пространстве есть место навыку и: In such a space there is a place for skill and inexperience. However, an invitation to participate does not mean that you have to do it loudly. You can listen, maintain a familiar rhythm, or wait until someone else's song ends. Attentive participation often gives a greater sense of common cause than trying to immediately show everything you can do.
Общий ритм не бывает единственным: The general rhythm is not the only one
Одни люди приезжают ради музыки и встреч: Some people come for music and meetings, others need silence and sleep. Parents who work in the kitchen and those who have recently arrived may have very different days. The forest carries sound well over a distance, and the personal feeling “we are not disturbing anyone” does not always coincide with what the neighbors hear.
Акустическая музыка позволяет слышать и: Acoustic music allows you to hear both the instruments and the people around you. Find out local agreements about technology and silence, listen to neighboring tents. If you want to play until the morning, first think about those who got up in the kitchen or put the child to bed. A general rhythm is achieved when there is room in it for both the joy of meeting and peaceful sleep.
Общий круг может соединять еду с песней,: A shared circle can pair food with song, silence, or words of gratitude. For some, this is an important spiritual action; for others, it is a moment of meeting people after a working day. The same movement does not mean the same inner meaning, and it is useful to notice this diversity without trying to immediately reduce it to one belief.
Присутствовать уважительно можно по-разн: There are different ways to be respectfully present. A person does not have to share the wording of the prayer or participate in the singing in order to stand quietly nearby. If a practice is unclear, asking about it is better than imitating it for fear of standing out. Personal participation becomes more meaningful when there is still a choice in it.
На некоторых встречах мы собираемся для: At some meetings we gather for general silence: to sit down, listen to the forest, to be nearby without words. Somewhere such a circle is associated with the full moon, somewhere with another day or tradition. Find out what's happening right here. You can join if this is close to you, or respectfully leave silence for those who need it now.
Молчание может дать редкую возможность з: Silence can provide a rare opportunity to notice habitual impulses: to speak first, fill a pause, or explain an experience to another. But a person does not need to promise himself a special effect. One can simply respect those who participate and choose an appropriate way to be present without declaring that one practice fits all.
Встречи соединяют людей с разными духовн: Meetings bring together people with different spiritual and cultural influences. Sometimes with them come words, symbols and forms borrowed from other communities. Their presence begs the question of origins and who has the right to represent a particular tradition. A beautiful title does not replace such a conversation.
Если тебя приглашают в незнакомую практи: If you are invited to an unfamiliar practice, ask about its meaning and origin. You can listen, not participate, or refuse without explanation. Respect for the traditions of other peoples begins with a willingness to learn from the people who preserve them. For intimacy there is no need to repeat every external form; It is much more important to pay attention to those around you.
Что можно увезти без фотографии: What can you take away without a photo?
Не каждое важное мгновение нужно превращ: Not every important moment needs to be recorded. Sometimes what remains is a melody, a way of listening, or a memory of someone giving way to another voice. These are also historical materials, although they do not always end up in the public archive. A camera can help memory, but it requires people's consent and attention to the situation.
Если хочется продолжить общий ритм дома,: If you want to continue the general rhythm at home, you don’t have to reproduce the whole camp. You can get together for dinner, play music with friends, or leave a little more pause in the conversation. The cultural life of the meeting becomes part of everyday life when not only the image of the forest is transferred, but also the skill of noticing those who are nearby.
